decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 0900 hours to 2200 hours Monday to Friday, Saturdays 0900 and 1200 hours to 2300 hours on Sundays 1000 and 2200.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - The proposed duct as shown on plans no. 2059-03/FP shall comprise a three-stage system to include grease, pre-and carbon filter that should terminate at least one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises. The duct should terminate pointing upwards and lightweight flaps and other covers which open when the system is powered should be fitted and the system shall be serviced regularly.

Condition : 6 - The proposed duct as shown on plan 2059-03/FP shall not cause an increase in background noise level (BNL) in the vicinity. When the system is operating at maximum, the noise level should be 10dB (A) lower than the BNL. To achieve this standard the following measure shall be adopted;?	The fan unit and filters may need to be located within the building.?	Silencers shall be provided to one of both sides of the fan as necessary.?	If the fan unit is to be located outside the building then it may be necessary to provide an acoustic enclosure.?	Ducting shall be configured to minimise turbulent airflow. Acute bends and duct constrictions shall be minimised.?	Ducting shall be circular.?	The fan should be isolated from inlet and outlet ducting using flexible couplings?	The fan shall be mounted using anti-vibration mounts (this is particularly important if it is proposed to fix the fan unit to nay common structure).?	The ducting shall be isolated from the building structure using anti-vibration mountings and a packing material where it passes through any solid structure (this is important if the transmission of vibration through common structure is to be avoided).
